implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning repository's Search recipe test and versioned Search documentation changed, plus this scope's evidence. No production Search source, sibling repository or publication state was changed.
implementation.workflowContract: search.lines establishes one physical-line candidate row; a CTE carries Path, coordinates, OccurrenceCount and raw LineText into one outer TryParse<LogRecord> application. Primitive parsed fields support successful ID aggregation while null fields and raw input preserve malformed candidates.
implementation.completenessContract: The literal Search source is a candidate prefilter. A line without the mandatory ERROR token is outside the candidate result and cannot support a negative completeness claim without a separate complete scope.

gateResults.evidence: The Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,626 total tests, 1,592 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the new recipe tests and Search suite also passed. The suite emitted existing package-vulnerability, documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings but no test or command failure.

The separate review approved one-pass candidate parsing, occurrence-count handling, tolerant malformed-row retention, candidate-boundary semantics, UTF-16 coordinates and fixture cleanup; tested source hashes and the review artifact are retained.

The fixture asserts exact parsed IDs, three candidate lines, five matching occurrences, one malformed raw line, absent INFO prefilter candidate and exact multibyte UTF-16 match coordinates; the registered semantic harnesses also passed.

The documented CTE plus outer TryParse composition compiles and runs against isolated fixtures, while Search occurrence and coordinate behavior are exercised by the executable tests and registered contracts.

knownLimitations: The literal search is a candidate prefilter; missing-token absence is not a complete negative result without an independently complete scope.

TryParse preserves malformed evidence through null primitive fields and raw LineText; PartialParse diagnostics remain a separate contract because its dictionary is not a valid query-output type in this evaluator.
The recipe is line-oriented and makes no claim about formal log-language semantics or runtime configuration correctness.

The owning-repository suite retained existing restore, package-vulnerability, XML-documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings; no warning was introduced by the Search build, which passed with -warnaserror.
No package was published, pushed, released or installed, and no sibling repository was edited.
